title: Insurance Claim Services Final Mold Supplement — Air Lines by Tier
content:
**Rule.** For an Insurance Claim Services final mold supplement, the air treatment is taken as follows: on a tier that requires both containment and negative air, the containment setup line, the air scrubber day charges and the dehumidifier day charges billed on the job, because both machines run inside the held containment; on a tier that requires negative air but no containment, the air scrubber day charges billed on the job; on any other tier, the dehumidifier day charges billed on the job.

The tier is that of the Mold Remediation job awaiting clearance; lines are taken at the amount billed on it.

| Mold Remediation tier | Containment required | Negative air required | Billable equipment day cap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Spot Mold Remediation | no | no | 2 |
| Limited Mold Remediation | yes | yes | 3 |
| Standard Mold Remediation | yes | yes | 4 |
| Extensive Mold Remediation | yes | yes | 6 |
| Attic and Crawlspace Mold Remediation | yes | yes | 4 |
| HVAC System Mold Remediation | no | yes | 3 |

*Hypothetical:* a Standard Mold Remediation job billing a containment setup of 375.00, air scrubber days of 270.00 and dehumidifier days of 210.00: 855.00. An HVAC System Mold Remediation job billing air scrubber days of 180.00 and dehumidifier days of 140.00: 180.00. A Spot Mold Remediation job billing dehumidifier days of 140.00: 140.00. A Spot Mold Remediation job billing dehumidifier days of 140.00: 140.00.
